prompts.display_text: Pin a country whose king, queen or president was given a Book of Mormon, per the Church's country chronologies
prompts.text_original: A country whose king, queen or president received a copy of the Book of Mormon from Church representatives, as recorded in the Church's Global Histories chronologies
prompts.citation: Global Histories chronologies: Sweden, Netherlands, Costa Rica, Panama, Thailand, Slovakia
prompts.note: Scoped to the Global Histories chronologies read 27 Oct 2026; leaders of other countries have also received copies.
prompts.summary: Church representatives have often given the Book of Mormon to heads of state. The Church's country chronologies record gifts to King Oscar II of Sweden in 1897, the Dutch royal family in 1888 and 1952, Costa Rica's president in 1947, Panama's in 1961, the king of Thailand in 1968 and Slovakia's president in 1999.

answers.name: Netherlands
answers.fact: A copy of John Volker's 1888 Dutch translation went to the king and queen; Queen Juliana later accepted one after meeting David O. McKay in 1952.

answers.name: Sweden
answers.fact: Jan M. Sjodahl presented a copy to King Oscar II in 1897, his 25th year on the throne.

answers.name: Panama
answers.fact: Marion G. Romney presented a copy to President Roberto F. Chiari in 1961.

answers.name: Thailand
answers.fact: Ezra Taft Benson gave King Bhumibol Adulyadej an English copy in Bangkok in 1968.

answers.name: Costa Rica
answers.fact: President Teodoro Picado was given a copy in San Jose in 1947.

answers.name: Slovakia
answers.fact: President Rudolf Schuster and his wife accepted a copy at a Church open house in Bratislava in 1999.

prompts.display_text: Pin a Latin American or Caribbean country or territory where a current Seventy once led a mission (October 2026).
prompts.text_original: As of October 2026, many General Authority Seventies had led missions in Latin America and the Caribbean. Pin a country or territory there where one of those missions was headquartered, as named in the Church's official biographies.
prompts.summary: Latin America has given many Seventies their first experience leading missionaries. As of October 2026, their biographies name missions they led in ten countries and territories, from Brazil and Mexico to Uruguay, Ecuador and Puerto Rico.

answers.name: Brazil
answers.fact: Belo Horizonte, Rio de Janeiro South, Belem and Brasilia missions, among others.

answers.name: Mexico
answers.fact: Mexico Monterrey East, Mexico City South and Tijuana missions (Elders Walker, Casillas, Alonso).

answers.name: Argentina
answers.fact: Argentina Cordoba Mission (Elder Alliaud).

answers.name: Chile
answers.fact: Chile Santiago North (Elder Duncan) and Chile Antofagasta (Elder Wu) missions.

answers.name: Guatemala
answers.fact: Guatemala City Central Mission (Elder Hugo E. Martinez).

answers.name: Peru
answers.fact: Peru Lima Central Mission (Elder Strong).

answers.name: Uruguay
answers.fact: Uruguay Montevideo (Elder Eddy) and Montevideo West (Elder Olsen) missions.

answers.name: Dominican Republic
answers.fact: Dominican Republic Santo Domingo East Mission (Elder Corbitt).

answers.name: Ecuador

answers.fact: Elder Kevin G. Brown led the Jamaica Kingston Mission, 2013 to 2016.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country holding a people judged in Zephaniah 2: Philistines, Moab, Ammon, Assyria, or the Nile land of Cush
prompts.text_original: A present-day country holding a people judged in Zephaniah 2 (Philistines, Moab, Ammon, the Ethiopians of Cush on the Nile, Assyria)
prompts.note: Bible Ethiopia (Cush) lay in today's Sudan, so modern Ethiopia is not counted.
prompts.summary: Zephaniah 2 calls Judah to seek meekness, then names the peoples who will be judged: the Philistine cities of Gaza, Ashkelon, Ashdod and Ekron, Moab and Ammon, the Ethiopians, and Assyria with its capital Nineveh. The Bible's Ethiopia, or Cush, was the Nile land south of Egypt, today Sudan, not modern Ethiopia.

answers.name: Iraq
answers.fact: The Lord will destroy Assyria and make Nineveh a desolation (Zephaniah 2:13).

answers.name: Israel
answers.fact: Ashkelon, Ashdod and Ekron were Philistine cities (Zephaniah 2:4).

answers.name: Jordan
answers.fact: Moab and the children of Ammon shall be as Sodom (Zephaniah 2:8-9).

answers.name: Palestine
answers.fact: Gaza shall be forsaken (Zephaniah 2:4); it lies in the Gaza Strip.

answers.name: Sudan
answers.fact: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain (Zephaniah 2:12); Bible Ethiopia, or Cush, ran south from Syene along the Nile, today Sudan.
